proyectos.descripcion_corta: Food ordering platform connecting restaurants and customers
proyectos.resumen: Restaurants need a digital platform to manage orders and reach more customers. That’s why we designed a complete system with backend and mobile apps for both customers and restaurant owners. The result: a functional MVP inspired by Glovo/UberEats, including order management, product catalogues, restaurant listings, and user accounts.

detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Client-server with REST API; separate mobile apps for customers and owners
detalles_tecnicos.rol: Backend development for customer orders and frontend implementation for the customer app

proceso: We were given the initial web platform schema and requirements in class (business rules, functional and non-functional requirements).
I implemented the backend in Node.js and Express, connecting it to MariaDB for data persistence.
We built a REST API to handle all CRUD operations (restaurants, products, and orders) following the rules (e.g., free shipping for orders > €10, one restaurant per order, etc.).
I also contributed to the React Native app for customers, integrating API endpoints and ensuring smooth order creation and tracking.
Finally, we documented everything (requirements, use cases, and technical architecture) and tested scalability and security using libraries like Sequelize and Helmet.

proyectos.descripcion_corta: Documentation and analysis of requirements for a software system
proyectos.resumen: The challenge: before coding any system, it is crucial to understand what the users need and what constraints exist. For this academic project, we worked with a real client who required a new website. We analyzed their current processes and designed improved workflows, identifying requirements and opportunities for optimization. The outcome: two detailed requirement documents, including actors, goals, business rules, functional and non-functional requirements, and UML models. These deliverables provide a solid foundation for any future software development.

detalles_tecnicos.enfoque: Requirements engineering, UML modeling, business rules
detalles_tecnicos.entregables: Requirement documents, use cases, conceptual models, constraints
detalles_tecnicos.estado: Academic project — documentation only (no product built)

proceso: Contacted the client and identified the main stakeholders and their goals.
Documented current business processes and proposed improved workflows.
Defined functional, non-functional requirements, and business rules.
Designed UML diagrams (use case, class, activity) to support the specification.
Consolidated everything into a formal requirements document ready for future development.

proyectos.descripcion_corta: Academic project in Java to process and analyze real baseball data, developed during my first year of university.
proyectos.resumen: The challenge was to design a system capable of working with a real dataset (baseball Statcast data) while applying object-oriented programming concepts. My approach started by exploring the dataset itself: understanding what kind of insights could be extracted and how to leverage the data effectively. I then implemented domain classes, object factories, and data structures (maps and collections) to represent and query the data. The result was a structured Java program that performed meaningful analyses (e.g. comparing players or plays) using collections and streams.

detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Domain classes + object factory + collection-based containers
detalles_tecnicos.rol: Full development — dataset exploration, data modeling, and implementation of operations

proceso: Explored the Statcast dataset to identify interesting metrics and insights.
Designed domain classes to represent pitches, games, and players.
Implemented collections and dictionaries (maps) to organize data efficiently.
Applied streams to query, filter, and analyze data in a functional style.
Structured the solution with factories and modular design for maintainability.

proyectos.descripcion_corta: End-to-end pipeline to process, enrich, and adapt chatbot conversations for a mental health application.
proyectos.resumen: During my professional experience, I was tasked with adapting a mental health chatbot to different cultural contexts. To address this, I designed an NLP pipeline capable of cleaning raw data, extracting conversational context, and generating embeddings with multiple LLMs. This work delivered production-ready datasets for training, a comparative analysis of OpenAI and Gemini embeddings, and the generation of synthetic “red flag” phrases for moderation and cultural adaptation.

detalles_tecnicos.stack: Python, NumPy, OpenAI API, Gemini API
detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Modular Jupyter notebooks covering cleaning, embeddings, data generation, and analysis
detalles_tecnicos.rol: Designed and implemented the pipeline — data preprocessing, embeddings generation, cross-model comparison, and synthetic dataset creation for moderation

proceso: Standardized and cleaned raw Excel conversations into structured JSON datasets.
Implemented embeddings generation with both OpenAI and Gemini, developing a cosine similarity–based comparison tool.
Created a synthetic dataset generator to produce culturally sensitive “red flag” phrases for moderation testing.

proyectos.descripcion_corta: My personal portfolio built with HTML and CSS, showcasing projects, experience, skills, and professional contact information.
proyectos.resumen: This website serves as my professional portfolio, organized into sections such as “About Me”, “Projects”, and “Contact”. It was designed to be clean, fully responsive, and easy to navigate — highlighting my technical skills and relevant experiences.

detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Modular structure with semantic sections and reusable containers
detalles_tecnicos.rol: Interface design, layout, and styling of the full portfolio

proceso: Designed the semantic HTML structure using consistent sections and containers.
Styled the site with CSS, leveraging variables, grids, and flexbox for consistency and responsiveness.
Optimized navigation and user experience across desktop and mobile devices.
Added GitHub and professional contact links while highlighting projects and technical skills.

proyectos.descripcion_corta: Academic Python project analyzing MBA student data and employability.
proyectos.resumen: The challenge was to work with a real MBA student dataset and extract insights on grades and employability. The solution involved building a Python system using namedtuples, filters, statistics, and visualizations to explore and analyze the data. The result was a robust academic project that allowed a thorough examination of key factors affecting MBA student employability.

detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Independent modules (analysis, tests, visualization) + CSV dataset
detalles_tecnicos.rol: Full development of the project, from data preprocessing to analysis and visualization

proceso: Chose a relevant dataset of MBA students and explored its structure and variables.
Implemented Python namedtuples to store structured student data efficiently.
Developed filtering and analysis functions to extract key insights on grades and employability factors.
Created visualizations using Matplotlib to present findings clearly and intuitively.
Performed unit testing to ensure accuracy of analysis functions and correctness of results.

proyectos.descripcion_corta: Decision-based game with Sevillian humor, inspired by Reigns.
proyectos.resumen: This project was a fun side project inspired by the game Reigns. I designed a small, interactive game set in Sevilla, featuring local humor and absurd scenarios. Players make decisions by swiping left or right, and each choice affects the game state, such as popularity, wealth, or relationships. The game showcases a modular architecture, visual enhancements, and dynamic outcomes, providing both entertainment and a learning experience in game development and UI design.

detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Modular Pygame structure (folders core, screens, ui, data)

proceso: Designed a modular structure separating screens, game logic, and data.
Implemented left/right swipe animations for decision-making in the style of Reigns.
Developed a system for win/lose conditions with personalized end messages loaded from JSON.
Enhanced the UI with visual elements: stats container with tiles, cleaner interface, and local humor integration.

proyectos.nombre: VRP solved by clustering and genetic algorithm
proyectos.descripcion_corta: Application for solving the Vehicle Routing Problem using clustering and genetic algorithms to optimize distribution routes.
proyectos.resumen: The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) is a classic logistics optimization challenge. To tackle it, I combined a clustering algorithm to group nearby customers and a genetic algorithm to optimize routes within each cluster. This approach reduced total travel distance, improved fleet utilization, and provided a clear framework for analyzing route efficiency.

detalles_tecnicos.arquitectura: Modular script with separate modules for clustering, fitness evaluation, crossover, mutation, and visualization
detalles_tecnicos.rol: Algorithm design, implementation, and visualization of results

proceso: Defined the customer dataset and distance function to model the problem.
I implemented clustering (K-means) to reduce complexity by dividing customers by proximity.
I designed a genetic algorithm with selection, crossover, and mutation operators to find efficient routes within each cluster.
I visualized the resulting routes to analyze improvements over the initial solutions.
